narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On June 11, 2024, at approximately 0930 hours, Border Patrol Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] assisted the Monroe County Sheriff's Office with a person who could not produce identification after a workplace inspection near Monroe, Michigan. Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] interviewed the subject, who stated that he is a citizen of Mexico and has no immigration documents allowing him to be in the United States.
IMMIGRATION HISTORY:
Fingerprint checks of the subject returned an alien file. Records show that the subject was ordered removed by an immigration judge in San Antonio, Texas, on 05/02/2014, and that he was physically removed to Mexico through the Laredo, Texas, port of entry on 05/20/2014.
ENTRY:
The subject stated that he re-entered the United States in late 2015 by crossing the river near Laredo, Texas, without inspection. He was carrying a Mexican birth certificate.
TRAVEL:
He stated that he travelled by car to Detroit in 2016.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
The subject was transported to the [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] Station and processed. A Notice to Appear was prepared and the case was referred for review.
